description:
Responsibilities: 
 Collaborate with the team to design, develop, implement, and verify both front-end and back-end applications operating in a highly secure data environment.
 Conduct unit testing and other relevant testing techniques to ensure application quality and scalability, in close coordination with the dedicated Solution Architect.
 Implement Continuous Integration (CI) pipelines to maintain and improve ongoing application quality.
 Participate in technical reviews of your own work and that of others to ensure code quality and knowledge sharing.
 Maintain and enhance existing applications, ensuring long-term stability and performance.
 Proactively identify opportunities for application improvements and drive ideas through to implementation.
 Work within an Agile development environment and contribute to the continuous improvement of Agile processes.
 Collaborate closely with the Trust Provisioning Global team based in Hamburg, Germany to develop a unified, standardized technology platform for deployment across global test centers.
 Coordinate with 1st Line and 2nd Line support teams to ensure timely resolution of production incidents.
 Propose and implement new solutions that assist support teams in their daily operations by preventing issues or enabling rapid identification and resolution when problems occur.
 
 Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field, with at least 3 years of experience in software development.
 Strong knowledge of C# .NET, design patterns, and object-oriented programming.
 Strong proficiency in front-end development using AngularJS or similar frameworks (e.g., React, Vue.js).
 Solid understanding of JSON and RESTful API services.
 Experience with WCF, web services, and Windows services.
 Proficient in MS SQL Server and basic T-SQL.
 Familiarity with unit testing practices and frameworks.
 Experience with containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
 Commitment to writing clean, maintainable, and high-quality code.
 Experience with Continuous Integration (CI) is a plus.
 Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools such as TFS is an advantage.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Good awareness of risk and mitigation strategies.
 Ability to multitask and manage multiple priorities effectively.
 Excellent team player with a collaborative mindset.
 Basic understanding of semiconductor technology and design workflows.
 Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
 
 More information about NXP in Thailand...
